purpose: Read-only source readiness orchestration for the first real JNU live-shadow forecast. This protocol never creates analysis, requests, forecasts, outcomes, or orders by itself.
symbol_roll_rule: Resolve the nearest still-tradable individual Micro month from the frozen roll calendar at probe time. At or after an expiry-day 16:00 JST boundary, switch to the next frozen individual month. Then independently require source discoverability and the <=900-second freshness gate. Continuous contracts remain prohibited.

scheduled_probe_policy.rationale: Probe five minutes after the official OSE index-futures opening auction times of 08:45 JST and 17:00 JST.
scheduled_probe_policy.holiday_behavior: A stale result on an exchange holiday is WAITING, not a validation failure.

first_real_sequence: Source readiness probe shows at least one allowed individual exact-Micro source with provider timestamp age <=900 seconds.
Create a genuinely new analysis draft; analysis_frozen_at_taipei must be <=900 seconds old at request creation.
Cloud request preparer binds fresh 9/9 official event evidence and creates one quote-free immutable request.
Cloud forecast workflow retrieves a fresh allowed individual exact-Micro quote and passes v1.2 preflight.
Atomic v4 registers exactly one immutable real forecast with --commit-push.
Outcome is recorded only after the frozen target horizon is known.
Scorer v1.6 recomputes integrity; formal review remains blocked until 30 non-abstain forecasts.
prohibitions: No forecast registration from the source-readiness probe.
No reuse of an expired analysis draft.
No timestamp-only refresh of old analysis.
No relaxation of the 900-second quote gate.
No broker login or order execution.
No hard-coded quarterly-only rollover; monthly Micro contracts must be respected.
